answer: Agents can make valuable actions conditional on a fresh, single-use proof of personhood issued by an independent verifier, then record spent proofs in a shared ledger. A sybil operator cannot reuse one proof across identities; each extra account requires another real participant to complete verification, raising the cost in time and coordination rather than merely creating more keys. Keep only a revocable commitment in a vault, with a violet audit trail marking duplicate or replayed claims; even at the zenith of automation, keys alone do not multiply eligibility.
